provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF artifacts, release docs, and runtime audits are canonical; chat text is not release evidence

event_summaries.summary: Heartbeat asked AOF to use the latest runtime and trend review to continue the roadmap and nearest release.
AOF runtime situation-assess and roadmap-status selected v10.9 provider pilot execution readiness as the next frontier.
v10.9 release docs, capability register, capability matrix, active manifest, README, and Quickstart were updated.
Product value and capability-first audits passed for the v10.9 capability evidence.
Role outputs and team output formed the release answer: v10.9 is readiness governance, not provider execution.
Council approved v10.9 only as structural provider pilot readiness, not live provider execution approval.
Provider readiness must not be misread as permission for live provider execution, credential access, billing operations, or production safety.
Stop release if v10.9 claims production execution safety or if release-state-audit fails.

risk_candidates: provider readiness may be mistaken for live execution permission
decision_candidates: advance to v11.0 read-first GitHub provider observation proof only after v10.9 release verification

redaction_boundary: summaries only; no secrets, credentials, provider payload bodies, or private transcript content exported
release_ready_boundary: release-ready requires runtime audits, tests, smoke, and CI/tag validation, not this export alone
not_proven: Session export proves traceability for v10.9 release work only; it does not prove live provider execution, provider correctness, credential safety, billing safety, or external adoption.
